announcements.headline: Nelly Group appoints Lars Gezelius as new CEO
announcements.insight: Lars Gezelius replaces Josefin Dalum as CFO. This leadership change coincides with an ongoing share repurchase programme initiated in July.

announcements.headline: Josefin Dalum resigns as CFO of Nelly Group
announcements.insight: Josefin Dalum resigns as CFO. This board change follows recent share repurchases initiated in July and executed in September.

announcements.headline: Repurchases of ordinary shares in Nelly Group during week 38, 2026
announcements.insight: Nelly Group AB continues its share repurchase programme initiated in July. This execution of the approved buyback is a routine capital return action for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Nelly Group initiates share repurchase programme of up to SEK 30 million
announcements.insight: The company has initiated a share repurchase programme of up to SEK 30 million. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on execution and timing.
